Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 27, "heading": "CHAPTER 25. GOOD AND BAD ANGELS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u027-b0126", "target": "— Ох, очень неосторожен, молодой господин Копперфилд, — отозвался Урия, скромно вздыхая. — Ох, очень! Но я бы хотел, чтобы вы звали меня Урия, если вам угодно. Это как в старые времена.", "source_sha256": "475dc893693198b811affb078e2f31ec9a16c507ce0a826354883516398ed2eb", "target_id": "ru-en85-u027-b0126", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "02539e218554904d9cd905e6b72dc8d855a4b4ed2ecc2b16ac80f2539641a330"}, {"source_id": "en85-u027-b0127", "target": "— Ну что ж! Урия, — сказал я, с трудом выдавив это из себя.", "source_sha256": "b79fe0eb726c18d1afdd5daf982138b7857ff9420641a9c97601f5dfdc1d0693", "target_id": "ru-en85-u027-b0127", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e67f37b01f57f84b3762c786974e2415a343448611ce5495c1cc7dc0c865e9e0"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 25, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u027-b0128", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Thank you,’ he returned, with fervour. ‘Thank you, Master Copperfield! It’s like the blowing of old breezes or the ringing of old bellses to hear YOU say Uriah. I beg your pardon. Was I making any observation?’", "sha256": "777dc6e1eb94de53ee50e03d99df0b1109d17b227f31e9bd459297693f73b868", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[129]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0129", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘About Mr. Wickfield,’ I suggested.", "sha256": "a2cf34db4ad32cfae34319b4c899548ae206a6bb7aa5b0916391993e1b772d0a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[130]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0130", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh! Yes, truly,’ said Uriah. ‘Ah! Great imprudence, Master Copperfield. It’s a topic that I wouldn’t touch upon, to any soul but you. Even to you I can only touch upon it, and no more. If anyone else had been in my place during the last few years, by this time he would have had Mr. Wickfield (oh, what a worthy man he is, Master Copperfield, too!) under his thumb. Un—der—his thumb,’ said Uriah, very slowly, as he stretched out his cruel-looking hand above my table, and pressed his own thumb upon it, until it shook, and shook the room.", "sha256": "b1bfac8d4cdd8e6f071f3e6cb0d91db8ffd74fae494d9a804c5c974300e431b4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[131]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0131", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "If I had been obliged to look at him with him splay foot on Mr. Wickfield’s head, I think I could scarcely have hated him more.", "sha256": "b6f60bf0d581563bd32907c0415c5431410f3f2155a5e38a35c47bc09c9b65f8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[132]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0132", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, dear, yes, Master Copperfield,’ he proceeded, in a soft voice, most remarkably contrasting with the action of his thumb, which did not diminish its hard pressure in the least degree, ‘there’s no doubt of it. There would have been loss, disgrace, I don’t know what at all. Mr. Wickfield knows it. I am the umble instrument of umbly serving him, and he puts me on an eminence I hardly could have hoped to reach. How thankful should I be!’ With his face turned towards me, as he finished, but without looking at me, he took his crooked thumb off the spot where he had planted it, and slowly and thoughtfully scraped his lank jaw with it, as if he were shaving himself.", "sha256": "25195010ef69f5276013a9b7205cb131e54e7384abe25c87e1f4b84df6461336", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[133]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0133", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I recollect well how indignantly my heart beat, as I saw his crafty face, with the appropriately red light of the fire upon it, preparing for something else.", "sha256": "3b9e3d54c198cb09b5f12d13cb4a076ef4b30f92f95d237093371b85ebe66ed5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[134]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0134", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Master Copperfield,’ he began—‘but am I keeping you up?’", "sha256": "2644e708eb3c5ebedd5ea4d8f13a1356cf984995327569780a58e7d8d0f47e38", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[135]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0135", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You are not keeping me up. I generally go to bed late.’", "sha256": "ca85535e1c983f18d564b84a9602af7ad21c0f76323e6b1cd7083637e5a6516e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[136]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0136", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Thank you, Master Copperfield! I have risen from my umble station since first you used to address me, it is true; but I am umble still. I hope I never shall be otherwise than umble. You will not think the worse of my umbleness, if I make a little confidence to you, Master Copperfield? Will you?’", "sha256": "3c67f18a0945d46f5430aafd11231146b38c303ccfcabbaaf7aaf15dc892b869", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[137]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0137", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh no,’ said I, with an effort.", "sha256": "0632b5ecda37ef587178e7a8d1b324611b94038f58cbfcac94fd6bd8dcd2e9fb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[138]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0138", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Thank you!’ He took out his pocket-handkerchief, and began wiping the palms of his hands. ‘Miss Agnes, Master Copperfield—’ ‘Well, Uriah?’", "sha256": "906b63b2f0f410f3a0feaf19942631e1ee44b6672c8cdc6cf53d078dc090798b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[139]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0139", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, how pleasant to be called Uriah, spontaneously!’ he cried; and gave himself a jerk, like a convulsive fish. ‘You thought her looking very beautiful tonight, Master Copperfield?’", "sha256": "a0608c5745322c35c8ea1e4aa115c318490148cef058b41566fc5bd137a99b74", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[140]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0140", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I thought her looking as she always does: superior, in all respects, to everyone around her,’ I returned.", "sha256": "c78ff7038b9b7f55c7aad3f88c6af6235f4dafa9535a7cf262787cad338be813", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[141]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0141", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, thank you! It’s so true!’ he cried. ‘Oh, thank you very much for that!’", "sha256": "cae96d05076c0e170de8d8a064f777f9138d7d27fc8e15ee6551dc8f168d6079", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[142]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0142", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not at all,’ I said, loftily. ‘There is no reason why you should thank me.’", "sha256": "9787d15e70ea6390fa29650a8159c1322bcb03ff4bf932b2a2c2906f9c4812cd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[143]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0143", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why that, Master Copperfield,’ said Uriah, ‘is, in fact, the confidence that I am going to take the liberty of reposing. Umble as I am,’ he wiped his hands harder, and looked at them and at the fire by turns, ‘umble as my mother is, and lowly as our poor but honest roof has ever been, the image of Miss Agnes (I don’t mind trusting you with my secret, Master Copperfield, for I have always overflowed towards you since the first moment I had the pleasure of beholding you in a pony-shay) has been in my breast for years. Oh, Master Copperfield, with what a pure affection do I love the ground my Agnes walks on!’", "sha256": "4747ea7791fe2501f75d88443a4fcc9dcec3fe4f9227ebda641af8a26f3c6d60", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[144]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0144", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I believe I had a delirious idea of seizing the red-hot poker out of the fire, and running him through with it. It went from me with a shock, like a ball fired from a rifle: but the image of Agnes, outraged by so much as a thought of this red-headed animal’s, remained in my mind when I looked at him, sitting all awry as if his mean soul griped his body, and made me giddy. He seemed to swell and grow before my eyes; the room seemed full of the echoes of his voice; and the strange feeling (to which, perhaps, no one is quite a stranger) that all this had occurred before, at some indefinite time, and that I knew what he was going to say next, took possession of me.", "sha256": "7559a587d33a474fa9dfdc55528b72520986bb301172801a3d34a6927510c481", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[145]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0145", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "A timely observation of the sense of power that there was in his face, did more to bring back to my remembrance the entreaty of Agnes, in its full force, than any effort I could have made. I asked him, with a better appearance of composure than I could have thought possible a minute before, whether he had made his feelings known to Agnes.", "sha256": "5b1cc3dcebae4618b9e3b1cd45cc46fcd5486730c1f8f0804e3f7b9dcb08ea53", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[146]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0146", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh no, Master Copperfield!’ he returned; ‘oh dear, no! Not to anyone but you. You see I am only just emerging from my lowly station. I rest a good deal of hope on her observing how useful I am to her father (for I trust to be very useful to him indeed, Master Copperfield), and how I smooth the way for him, and keep him straight. She’s so much attached to her father, Master Copperfield (oh, what a lovely thing it is in a daughter!), that I think she may come, on his account, to be kind to me.’", "sha256": "6646a94d4251146781a0aa0d65da3b03eded0734e4e7acf5636087faf25acc84", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[147]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0147", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I fathomed the depth of the rascal’s whole scheme, and understood why he laid it bare.", "sha256": "919cbe76a7769136cd9ae64107c914e425de15913f7944d9d4cfc2619a51412c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[148]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0148", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If you’ll have the goodness to keep my secret, Master Copperfield,’ he pursued, ‘and not, in general, to go against me, I shall take it as a particular favour. You wouldn’t wish to make unpleasantness. I know what a friendly heart you’ve got; but having only known me on my umble footing (on my umblest I should say, for I am very umble still), you might, unbeknown, go against me rather, with my Agnes. I call her mine, you see, Master Copperfield. There’s a song that says, “I’d crowns resign, to call her mine!” I hope to do it, one of these days.’", "sha256": "72a6fa73e32a91a679bac411facb8de765c1fd858c1ba389982e6e2e9eb56f8d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[149]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0149", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Dear Agnes! So much too loving and too good for anyone that I could think of, was it possible that she was reserved to be the wife of such a wretch as this!", "sha256": "68f2c8c18444b1067f7514e3c96825ce4198ddb5d70784a03de0fe41bc50cc68", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[150]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0150", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There’s no hurry at present, you know, Master Copperfield,’ Uriah proceeded, in his slimy way, as I sat gazing at him, with this thought in my mind. ‘My Agnes is very young still; and mother and me will have to work our way upwards, and make a good many new arrangements, before it would be quite convenient. So I shall have time gradually to make her familiar with my hopes, as opportunities offer. Oh, I’m so much obliged to you for this confidence! Oh, it’s such a relief, you can’t think, to know that you understand our situation, and are certain (as you wouldn’t wish to make unpleasantness in the family) not to go against me!’", "sha256": "b11106ce3acb8a4aa99b76dbb2e70ad65232f370915e98a545076dd33cb04090", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[151]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0151", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He took the hand which I dared not withhold, and having given it a damp squeeze, referred to his pale-faced watch.", "sha256": "e6ab190ecb86cb950bd5dbbecbae7cd891b864aaf4d9d3817b3b0580e1e05ef3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[152]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0152", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dear me!’ he said, ‘it’s past one. The moments slip away so, in the confidence of old times, Master Copperfield, that it’s almost half past one!’", "sha256": "cd6f0c3378e948e0fb83dcdec4f3aa76b9aad2a8246ac669a8b7020189d81f4a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[153]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0153", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I answered that I had thought it was later. Not that I had really thought so, but because my conversational powers were effectually scattered.", "sha256": "95abd260b5a64a1bb7d2c7f1f1b7d314aa29d3221783f92c56cceae20c70ef22", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[154]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0154", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dear me!’ he said, considering. ‘The ouse that I am stopping at—a sort of a private hotel and boarding ouse, Master Copperfield, near the New River ed—will have gone to bed these two hours.’", "sha256": "19d0f6d3efc9df6305bdd20ddbb50d6ac0f6a6f7fb29aaeb5e2b65426bbc81dc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[155]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0155", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am sorry,’ I returned, ‘that there is only one bed here, and that I—’", "sha256": "71099221a5f233fa560616584dd3f66c25b364cee08b8cdddc147fcee3c2f500", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[156]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0156", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, don’t think of mentioning beds, Master Copperfield!’ he rejoined ecstatically, drawing up one leg. ‘But would you have any objections to my laying down before the fire?’", "sha256": "dd0c12da1d383da804006fa0d4363d03313b603dc157e430009f0582d6db1fcd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[157]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0157", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If it comes to that,’ I said, ‘pray take my bed, and I’ll lie down before the fire.’", "sha256": "4bf1fa5164c53e088c0c782b9f4e5bead8ea9ebfeaf09f242c54a073e7f750e2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[158]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0158", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "His repudiation of this offer was almost shrill enough, in the excess of its surprise and humility, to have penetrated to the ears of Mrs. Crupp, then sleeping, I suppose, in a distant chamber, situated at about the level of low-water mark, soothed in her slumbers by the ticking of an incorrigible clock, to which she always referred me when we had any little difference on the score of punctuality, and which was never less than three-quarters of an hour too slow, and had always been put right in the morning by the best authorities. As no arguments I could urge, in my bewildered condition, had the least effect upon his modesty in inducing him to accept my bedroom, I was obliged to make the best arrangements I could, for his repose before the fire. The mattress of the sofa (which was a great deal too short for his lank figure), the sofa pillows, a blanket, the table-cover, a clean breakfast-cloth, and a great-coat, made him a bed and covering, for which he was more than thankful. Having lent him a night-cap, which he put on at once, and in which he made such an awful figure, that I have never worn one since, I left him to his rest.", "sha256": "4379c180dfbe7e7903d4bbdb16b7d80157d82e686f0e04b80b6cfaa3702252f8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[159]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u027-b0159", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I never shall forget that night. I never shall forget how I turned and tumbled; how I wearied myself with thinking about Agnes and this creature; how I considered what could I do, and what ought I to do; how I could come to no other conclusion than that the best course for her peace was to do nothing, and to keep to myself what I had heard. If I went to sleep for a few moments, the image of Agnes with her tender eyes, and of her father looking fondly on her, as I had so often seen him look, arose before me with appealing faces, and filled me with vague terrors. When I awoke, the recollection that Uriah was lying in the next room, sat heavy on me like a waking nightmare; and oppressed me with a leaden dread, as if I had had some meaner quality of devil for a lodger.", "sha256": "043ff1a9acf57ba0d11b185e61a12a17753bd6607f0f3f517e20f5a1dcf908c5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[32]/p[160]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
